components.institution_label: Seven-Month Leave Period under New York State Domestic Relations Law
components.description: Mandatory leave without pay for child care for up to seven months following delivery or adoption, for either parent; includes the birth parent's disability period after birth; if both parents are State employees, one at a time and a combined seven months.

components.duration_note: Counted from the date of delivery or adoption; where the child must stay in hospital after birth, it starts on the child's release on request; a later hospitalization suspends it, with the entitlement expiring one year after the leave began. notes: Governing documents for faculty leave are present (the UUP collective agreement 2011-2016, in force under status quo on the reference date per its version note, and the SUNY Board of Trustees Policies Article XIII), so missing is false. Article XIX of the Policies: where the agreement and the Policies differ, the agreement controls.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave: the HR page states 'The University at Albany does not provide a paid maternity leave'; pay during leave comes from the employee's own sick (disability period only) and vacation credits (vacation only for calendar and college year employees, not academic year faculty).

Birth parent chain: own sick credits for the pregnancy disability (up to 4 weeks before delivery, c3) -> from delivery, the seven-month child care leave without pay (c1), with FMLA (c2) concurrent from its start and own sick credits covering the post-birth disability period (up to 6 or 8 weeks) inside it -> discretionary child care leave beyond the seventh month (c14). Discretionary additional sick leave (c4 leave with c5 pay after credits, six months in total with credits; c6 unpaid up to a year) and long-term disability (c7 within c8, after a six-month elimination period) apply only to continuing disability.

Non-birth parent chain: seven-month child care leave without pay from delivery (c1), FMLA (c2) concurrent -> discretionary extension (c14); own family sick leave credits (c10, up to 30 days; HR page: spouse, about one week around delivery) unlinked.
If both parents are State employees, the seven-month leave is one parent at a time with a combined seven months (dual_employee_rule on c1); the figures assume no claim by the other parent.
Restriction: all leaves of absence terminate at the expiration of the employee's term appointment (Agreement 23.12; BOT XIII Title K); tenure-track faculty hold term appointments. Flagged on c1.

The seven-month child care leave rests on Agreement Appendix A-42 (an explanatory appendix 'not part of the collective bargaining agreement' to which the parties are 'fully committed') and the HR page; the statute it names (Domestic Relations Law art. 7) and the Civil Service attendance rules are not saved. Coded as statutory, statute_verified false; source status is an open point.

Documents cited but not saved: New York Domestic Relations Law Article 7; State University Group Disability Insurance Program; NYS Department of Civil Service Attendance and Leave Manual Appendix H (leave donation); UAlbany HR pages 'Expressing Breastmilk in the Workplace', 'Leave Donation', 'Classified Leave', 'Leave for Cancer Screening'; FMLA 'Employee Notice' and DOL Guide to Military FMLA; GOER VRWS page; 'Appendix A-46 of the Policies of the Board of Trustees, Article II(k) and (p)' (the Policies' Article II(k),(p) definitions are saved; no Appendix A-46 exists in them); University Senate Bill No. 8990-28; Memoranda of Understanding of 1981 and 1989 on professional evaluation and promotion (reproduced in App. A-28); NYS Work-Life Services materials.

Not components: sabbatical leave (professional development), employee organization leave, jury duty, designated and redeployment leaves, study leaves for presidents, extraordinary-circumstance absence, health-insurance maternity and newborn benefits, leave for cancer screening (effective 2018-03-18, not a parental provision).
No term or semester length is stated for the institution, so no calendar is recorded.
